status: NONVERDICT search outcomes plus one exact negative lemma about a candidate proof family; five-node conjecture still OPEN
finding: (1) The complete per-node dual (b>=0 against all four Kharitonov corners at each of five nodes, 20 rows) was implemented as a float matrix-game simplex (cross-checked against an exact z3 value: 2.0988e-7 both) and minimised adversarially over band-root eligible boxes for all three five-node phase patterns, both with member-magnitude normalisation and with row/column equilibration. No negative value was found; minimisers degenerate toward contacts (relative band gaps at the 3e-4 clamp) or a fifth node escaping to infinity, where the value tends to 0+. (2) Candidate proof family tested: nonnegative combinations of the four parity endpoints, b = l1 E_-(-s^2) + l2 E_+(-s^2) + s(n1 O_-(-s^2) + n2 O_+(-s^2)), i.e. parity-rescaled box members. It satisfies every SIGN requirement of pattern (2,1,3,2,4) automatically, but it is NOT universal: on an exactly eligible pattern-(2,1,3,5,4) box/node set the exact rational max-min over this family is -1.97e-4 (no member of the family pairs nonnegatively at all 20 rows), while the full nonnegative-numerator max-min is +3.03e-4 (so no certificate exists there). Float search had reported a positive family value at the same configuration; only the exact LP is trusted.

evidence.note: exact box (all four corners Hurwitz by exact Hurwitz minors, seven positive widths), exact nodes, both exact LP optima and the full witness weights

blocker: No universal low-dimensional witness family identified; the parity-endpoint family fails near contacts in pattern (2,1,3,5,4).
next_action: Independently replay the frozen family-failure record; then pursue a reduction route: a five-node septic certificate transfers verbatim to any family of degree <=7 that realises the same five node directions and is known to have a common numerator (stable segments of any order, quintic/sextic interval boxes). Test whether a stable equal-degree segment covering the certificate directions always exists.
scope: Exact rational LP optima (z3) and exact Hurwitz minors on one Python Eval host; float searches are nonverdict. Not parent-adopted, formal, cross-vendor or novelty-cleared.
